evidence.text:
### 大型星团珠宝可选的小天赋类型（17 种）

大型星团珠宝可加 8–12 个小天赋，有 5 个核心天赋位、3 个珠宝插槽位。

| 类型（PoB 英文原文） | 小天赋给予（英文原文） |
| --- | --- |
| Attack Damage | 10% increased Attack Damage |
| Attack Damage while Dual Wielding | 12% increased Attack Damage while Dual Wielding |
| Attack Damage while holding a Shield | 12% increased Attack Damage while holding a Shield |
| Axe and Sword Damage | Axe Attacks deal 12% increased Damage with Hits and Ailments；Sword Attacks deal 12% increased Damage with Hits and Ailments |
| Bow Damage | 12% increased Damage with Bows；12% increased Damage Over Time with Bow Skills |
| Chaos Damage | 12% increased Chaos Damage |
| Cold Damage | 12% increased Cold Damage |
| Dagger and Claw Damage | Claw Attacks deal 12% increased Damage with Hits and Ailments；Dagger Attacks deal 12% increased Damage with Hits and Ailments |
| Damage with Two Handed Weapons | 12% increased Damage with Two Handed Weapons |
| Elemental Damage | 10% increased Elemental Damage |
| Fire Damage | 12% increased Fire Damage |
| Lightning Damage | 12% increased Lightning Damage |

（共 17 种，以上列出前 12 种）

类型名与小天赋文本**只有英文**：POEDB 侧的中文附魔文本不在本库已缓存的任何一页上，所以按 PoB 原文给出，不自行翻译。

只给尺寸、小天赋数量与清单；**哪些核心天赋出现在哪种小天赋类型上未采集**（本地来源没有这个映射），也不提供掉落与价格。
